args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money (FIN-212)

round_money claimed banker's rounding but used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing
tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build.

args.head: fix/fin-212-half-even-rounding
args.title: Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` is documented as banker's rounding per FIN-212, but used `ROUND_HALF_UP`. This made `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` fail in the nightly build.

This PR switches the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. It is a one-line change in `src/money.py`.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit 08d3cd5986: passed.

## Notes
- Needed for today's release. Requires code-owner approval to merge into main.

- **CI:** Run `ci-0001` on that commit passed.
